name: history-manager
description: Browser-history-like navigation stack for SPAs — push, replace, and navigate entries with listener notifications, mirroring the History API semantics.
aiPromptContext: Use this block when building single-page application routers or wizard-style navigation flows that need a history stack without relying on the browser's window.history API. Supports push, replace, back, forward, and go(n) navigation with change listeners.

parameters.name: initialState
parameters.description: Optional initial state object for the first history entry.

parameters.name: initialUrl
parameters.description: Optional URL string for the initial history entry.
